author: Priya Sandoval, estates analyst
notes: The round finished on the 26th with two slots. The window itself runs to the 31st.
Owen tried the boiler house on the 26th to see whether the riser reads the same from down there. The desk handed the round back over the counter and charged the three slots anyway.
Fourteen slots left on the agreement. The desk will serve a round on any of the five days it has listed for February, one round a day.
The sheet has thirteen slots on it, all of them on the header.
